architecture_problem: F2 aggregate workpackage surfaces can drift behind granular terminal receipts/reconciliations, creating duplicate-work and false-priority risk. A prior Trigger-6 fusion already observed WP301/WP302 aggregate-vs-granular disagreement.

primary_sources.source: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center — CQRS Pattern
primary_sources.finding: When event sourcing is combined with CQRS, the event store remains the source of truth and read models/materialized views are derived and rebuildable; asynchronous read models may lag.

primary_sources.source: Microsoft Azure Architecture Center — Materialized View Pattern
primary_sources.finding: A materialized view is a disposable specialized cache that can be rebuilt from source data and should not be directly updated by the application.
Projection-owned output must not be mutated externally because that destroys projection predictability; reset returns to the source stream/checkpoint model and rebuilds from source.
Projection checkpoint/order streams make processing position and deterministic restart ordering explicit.
A high-water mark is held behind known sequence gaps so projections do not claim ordered progress past unresolved holes; projections can be rebuilt from source events.
Projection rebuild and projection-versioning are explicit operations; old/new projection versions can coexist while a new version catches up.

source_convergence: Granular authoritative evidence should remain separate from derived aggregate views.
Derived aggregate status should be reproducible from authoritative inputs, not directly edited as independent truth.
Projection progress/freshness must be explicit; a stale projection is not authoritative merely because it is internally consistent.
Projection algorithm/schema changes require rebuild/versioning rather than silent reinterpretation.
Output ownership must be single-writer/projector-owned to prevent untraceable drift.
f2_fit_hypothesis: Adopt the projection pattern structurally, not the external frameworks. A small deterministic F2 projector should derive machine and human workpackage status from exact granular terminal receipts/reconciliations and preserve conflicts/freshness metadata.
counterhypothesis: Manual aggregate maintenance plus periodic reconciliation may be simpler and sufficient; a projector could add complexity or encode wrong precedence rules and thereby automate false promotion.
next_discriminator: E2 map the smallest deterministic projection contract against current F2 evidence precedence and explicit conflict cases; require fail-closed CONFLICTED/STALE states and no runtime-credit promotion.
